title: CORE DataSink
description: Configuration for a data sink that receives transformed data from a CORE pipeline. Currently supports SQL databases via JDBC. The 'element' field references an Element by versioned CORE URN — this constraint is enforced in the DataSet context.

id.description: Versioned CORE URN of this DataSink.

connectionType.description: Protocol used by this data sink.

element.description: Versioned CORE URN of the Element that describes the output row format.

dbSchema.description: Database schema (namespace). Defaults to 'public' for PostgreSQL.

password.description: Database login password. Do not commit plaintext credentials — use secrets management in production.

url.description: HTTP endpoint URL for HTTP sinks.

contentType.description: Payload content type for HTTP sinks.
